guards: The sharpest control in the set, and the one that distinguishes matching on pharmacology from matching on drug class. Amlodipine beside metoprolol IS a calcium-channel blocker beside a beta-blocker, so a rule written against the class rather than against AV conduction flags it - and amlodipine, a dihydropyridine, is not chronotropic. Nothing else in the population separates those two implementations.

answer.intent: Near-miss control for the chronotropy class: amlodipine (a dihydropyridine) with metoprolol, no labs. Asserts no flag is raised.
